CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   C. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   D. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Samson kills a Lion? (1 mark)
   A. Say Samson kills a Lion has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Samson kills a Lion with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Samson kills a Lion.
   D. Use Samson kills a Lion to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Attributes of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Attributes of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Attributes of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of God.
   D. Apply the teaching of Attributes of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Patriarchs Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Patriarchs Abraham.
   B. Say Bible Patriarchs Abraham has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Bible Patriarchs Abraham to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Patriarchs Abraham with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.
   B. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   D. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   B. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   C. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fruit of the Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self-control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Use of Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Self-awareness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
